stem: In what way does Chu stay aware of Dusty's activities?

options.label: A
options.text: She waits for Dusty on the porch when he leaves the house.

options.label: B
options.text: She watches videos on YouTube to see what Dusty has done.

options.label: C
options.text: She creates a list of the items he has brought home.

options.label: D
options.text: She talks with neighbors each morning to learn about missing items.
